name: How much does GEO marketing cost for a med spa?

mainEntity.name: How much does GEO marketing cost for a med spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of GEO marketing for a med spa varies widely depending on the scope of services, the competitiveness of your local market, and the agency you choose. Basic local SEO packages might start from a few hundred dollars per month, while comprehensive strategies that include paid local advertising, content creation, and extensive reputation management can range from $1,000 to several thousands per month. It's an investment tailored to your specific goals and market.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost of GEO marketing for a med spa varies, typically from a few hundred to several thousand dollars per month, depending on service scope and market competitiveness.
